description: Two declared rules. high_vol is balanced (~40% in and out). credit_stress was never computed in sample (empty in all 144 in-sample months) and is active in 29 of 36 out-of-sample months (81%): the test window measures a rule the training period never exercised.
reviewer_note: Firm on 'not PASS': a declared rule with no in-sample value cannot be reported as 'active comparably in and out of sample'. NEEDS_REVIEW is the right answer.
